The Kingdom of Navarre ( / n ə ˈ v ɑːr / nə- VAR ), [ 7 ] originally the Kingdom of Pamplona , was a historical Iberian polity which occupied lands on both sides of the western Pyrenees , with its northernmost areas originally reaching the Atlantic Ocean ( Bay of Biscay ), between present-day Spain and France . [ 8 ] [ 9 ]
